remarks: Exceptional Opportunity in coveted New Canaan location. Don't miss this rare chance to own a beautifully updated home at the end of a quiet, protected cul-de-sac with just eight residences. Ideally situated within walking distance to schools, YMCA, Waveny Park, and downtown New Canaan, this property with over 3500 sq ft of living space, offers convenience and serenity in equal measure.  Enjoy effortless one-level living with an open-concept layout featuring a stunning Great Room, kitchen, and breakfast area - complete with cathedral ceilings and two fireplaces. The sun-filled living room boasts a fireplace, custom built-ins, and expansive views of the lush garden and flat, picturesque 1+ acre lot.  The home offers 4 bedrooms, the 4th bedroom is currently used as a home office. The spacious primary suite includes French doors leading to the backyard and a beautifully remodeled bathroom. A finished lower level provides versatile space for a recreation or playroom.  Additional highlights include an attached two-car garage, oversized septic system, Ct Basement system, new A/C, water heater, washer/dryer and the potential for a pool site. House is wired for portable generator included in sale. This is a truly special offering that rarely becomes available - an exceptional lifestyle opportunity in one of New Canaan's most desirable neighborhoods.
